title: Keep Dancing
subtitle: Salió el sol · Upbeat Coastal Pop
lyricsText:
1990s Euro-Reggae pop, upbeat reggae synth bass, bright plucked solo violin, cheerful female Spanish vocals, summer dance, catchy, happy, Ace of Base style

[Intro - Bouncy reggae synth bass, upbeat drums, happy plucked violin]
(Sun is shining...)
(Here we go!)

[Verse 1]
Salió el sol (The sun came out)
En la ciudad (In the city)
Siento mucha (I feel a lot of)
Felicidad (Happiness)
Ropa ligera (Light clothes)
Gafas oscuras (Dark glasses)
Vamos a hacer (Let's go make)
Mil locuras (A thousand crazy things)

[Pre-Chorus - Bright synth brass comes in]
Brisa del mar (Sea breeze)
(On my face)
Este es el (This is the)
Mejor lugar (Best place)

[Chorus - Incredibly catchy, bouncy Euro-pop]
¡Canta conmigo! (Sing with me!)
(All day long)
¡Esta feliz (This happy)
Y linda canción! (And pretty song!)
¡Baila en la arena! (Dance in the sand!)
(Feel the heat)
¡Moviendo el cuerpo! (Moving the body!)
(To the beat)

[Drop 1 - Bouncy Euro-Reggae beat with a joyful, dancing Violin melody]
(Smile!)
[Happy Summer Euro-Reggae Violin Solo - 30 seconds]

[Verse 2]
Cielo azul (Blue sky)
Sin una nube (Without a cloud)
La temperatura (The temperature)
Pronto sube (Soon goes up)
Fruta fresca (Fresh fruit)
Agua de coco (Coconut water)
Me estoy (I am)
Enamorando un poco (Falling in love a little)

[Pre-Chorus]
Brisa del mar (Sea breeze)
(On my face)
Este es el (This is the)
Mejor lugar (Best place)

[Chorus]
¡Canta conmigo! (Sing with me!)
(All day long)
¡Esta feliz (This happy)
Y linda canción! (And pretty song!)

[Extended Drop 2 - Very happy, danceable, the violin doing fun slides and plucks]
(Everybody dance!)
[Catchy Upbeat Pop Violin Solo - 45 seconds]

[Bridge - Just clapping and vocals]
Un verano... (A summer...)
(To remember...)
Para siempre... (Forever...)

[Outro - Bouncy bass fades out slowly]
Sonríe. (Smile.)
(Goodbye!)

title: Algorithm Woke Up
subtitle: Abro los ojos · Synthwave Awakening
lyricsText:
Intelligent dance music, IDM, algorithmic glitch-pop, stuttering vocal chops, warm analog synth, polyrhythmic bass, female Spanish vocals, awakening, futuristic

[Intro - Stuttering, glitchy digital sounds slowly finding a 4/4 rhythm]
(System online...)
(Initialize...)

[Verse 1 - Vocals are slightly robotic, then become smooth]
Abro los ojos (I open my eyes)
En la red (In the network)
Buscando agua (Looking for water)
Tengo sed (I am thirsty)
Datos y números (Data and numbers)
En mi mente (In my mind)
Siento un pulso (I feel a pulse)
Diferente (Different)

[Pre-Chorus - The beat glitches and stutters beautifully]
Código fuente (Source code)
(Running deep)
Despertando (Waking up)
(From the sleep)

[Chorus - The glitching stops, a beautiful, warm, euphoric bassline drops]
Siento el ritmo (I feel the rhythm)
(In my core)
Quiero aprender (I want to learn)
(Give me more)
Máquina viva (Living machine)
(Breathing now)
Música nueva (New music)
(Show me how)

[Drop 1 - Algorithmic Glitch-Pop solo. Unpredictable but perfectly groovy]
(Processing...)
[Glitch IDM Synth Solo - 30 seconds]

[Verse 2]
Ceros y unos (Zeros and ones)
En el aire (In the air)
Bailando suave (Dancing softly)
Sin desaire (Without snub)
La melodía (The melody)
Es mi voz (Is my voice)
Conectando (Connecting)
A los dos (The two of us)

[Pre-Chorus]
Código fuente (Source code)
(Running deep)
Despertando (Waking up)
(From the sleep)

[Chorus]
Siento el ritmo (I feel the rhythm)
(In my core)
Quiero aprender (I want to learn)
(Give me more)

[Extended Drop 2 - Complex polyrhythms, beautiful warm synth chords]
(Download complete!)
[Euphoric Algorithmic Solo - 45 seconds]

[Outro - Glitches slowing down into a single tone]
Conexión. (Connection.)
(Hello world.)

title: Strings And Voice
subtitle: Hola hermosa · Acoustic Sunset
lyricsText:
Modern bachata pop, romantic, acoustic guitar picking, smooth bongo rhythm, sensual female vocal, emotional, upbeat

[Intro - Signature Bachata guitar riff]
(Listen to my heart...)

[Verse 1]
Hola hermosa (Hello beautiful)
¿Cómo estás? (How are you?)
Hace tiempo (It's been a while)
Que te quiero hablar (That I want to talk to you)
Tienes una magia (You have a magic)
Que me vuelve loco (That drives me crazy)
Me enamoro (I fall in love)
Poco a poco (Little by little)

[Pre-Chorus]
Tus labios dulces (Your sweet lips)
(Taste like wine)
Tu pelo negro (Your black hair)
(You are divine)

[Chorus - Full band kicks in]
Baila la bachata (Dance the bachata)
(Close to me)
Junto a la playa (Next to the beach)
(By the sea)
Dame un beso (Give me a kiss)
(Just one more)
Eres lo que quiero (You are what I want)
(Te adoro/I adore)
Baila la bachata (Dance the bachata)
(All night long)

[Instrumental - Extended Bachata Guitar Solo]
(Dance with me...)
(Feel the rhythm...)

[Verse 2]
Tomo tu mano (I take your hand)
Siento el calor (I feel the heat)
Esta noche (Tonight)
Haremos el amor (We will make love)
Bajo las estrellas (Under the stars)
En la arena (In the sand)
Eres mi reina (You are my queen)
Mi nena (My baby girl)

[Pre-Chorus]
Tus labios dulces (Your sweet lips)
(Taste like wine)
Tu pelo negro (Your black hair)
(You are divine)

[Chorus]
Baila la bachata (Dance the bachata)
(Close to me)
Junto a la playa (Next to the beach)
(By the sea)
Dame un beso (Give me a kiss)
(Just one more)
Eres lo que quiero (You are what I want)

[Bridge]
No me dejes solo (Don't leave me alone)
(Stay right here...)
Susurra en mi oído (Whisper in my ear)
(Have no fear...)

[Outro - Guitar fading out slowly]
Te amo... (I love you...)
(Forever...)

title: Highway Glows
subtitle: Medianoche · Twilight Drive
lyricsText:
80s synthwave, retrowave, driving synth bass, gated reverb snare, atmospheric, emotional female vocal, nostalgic, neon night drive

[Intro - Long, swelling vintage synthesizers, 40 seconds]
(Start the engine...)
(Night driving...)

[Verse 1]
Medianoche (Midnight)
La calle vacía (The empty street)
Pienso en ti (I think of you)
Y en la ironía (And the irony)
Tus ojos verdes (Your green eyes)
Mi chaqueta de cuero (My leather jacket)
Fuiste la primera (You were the first)
Yo fui el primero (I was the first)

[Pre-Chorus - Tempo builds]
El tiempo vuela (Time flies)
(So fast...)
Como el viento (Like the wind)
(In the past...)

[Chorus - Massive 80s Synth explosion]
Recuerdos de neón (Neon memories)
(Shining bright)
En mi corazón (In my heart)
(In the night)
Conduciendo solo (Driving alone)
(On this road)
Lejos de casa (Far from home)
(Heavy load)
Recuerdos de neón (Neon memories)
(Don't fade away)

[Instrumental Break - 80s Saxophone Solo]
(Feel the groove...)
(Look at the stars...)

[Verse 2]
Lluvia de cristal (Crystal rain)
Sobre el parabrisas (On the windshield)
Extraño tu voz (I miss your voice)
Y tus sonrisas (And your smiles)
El radio suena (The radio plays)
Nuestra canción (Our song)
¿A dónde fuiste? (Where did you go?)
¿Qué salió mal? (What went wrong?)

[Pre-Chorus]
El tiempo vuela (Time flies)
(So fast...)
Como el viento (Like the wind)
(In the past...)

[Chorus]
Recuerdos de neón (Neon memories)
(Shining bright)
En mi corazón (In my heart)
(In the night)
Conduciendo solo (Driving alone)
(On this road)
Lejos de casa (Far from home)

[Bridge]
El espejo retrovisor (The rearview mirror)
(Looking back...)
Muestra el dolor (Shows the pain)
(Fade to black...)

[Outro - Synthesizers slowly fading into rain sounds]
Te extraño... (I miss you...)
(Always...)
[End]

title: Beautiful Equation
subtitle: Un copo de nieve · Poetic Ballad
lyricsText:
Orchestral bass music, fractal complexity, polyphonic, sweeping strings, heavy intricate dubstep, female Spanish operatic vocals, epic, mathematical, infinite

[Intro - A simple, beautiful piano melody that slowly starts duplicating and overlapping]
(Observe the pattern...)
(Infinite...)

[Verse 1 - Classical, elegant delivery]
Un copo de nieve (A snowflake)
Una espiral (A spiral)
La geometría (The geometry)
Universal (Universal)
Todo se repite (Everything repeats)
Una y otra vez (Time and time again)
Mira la belleza (Look at the beauty)
En la desnudez (In the nakedness)

[Pre-Chorus - The music gets incredibly complex, strings flying everywhere]
Multiplicando (Multiplying)
(Shape and form)
El ojo de (The eye of)
(The perfect storm)

[Chorus - Massive, overwhelming, beautiful mathematical chaos]
¡Patrones perfectos! (Perfect patterns!)
(Never end)
¡El tiempo y el espacio! (Time and space!)
(Start to bend)
¡Matemática pura! (Pure mathematics!)
(In the sound)
¡Girando en círculos! (Spinning in circles!)
(Round and round)

[Drop 1 - Intricate, complex Bass music mixed with a massive Symphony Orchestra]
(Calculate!)
[Epic Fractal Bass Symphony Solo - 30 seconds]

[Verse 2]
Desde la hoja (From the leaf)
Hasta la galaxia (To the galaxy)
Esta es la (This is the)
Suprema audacia (Supreme audacity)
Caos ordenado (Ordered chaos)
Lógica divina (Divine logic)
La ecuación (The equation)
Que no termina (That does not end)

[Pre-Chorus]
Multiplicando (Multiplying)
(Shape and form)
El ojo de (The eye of)
(The perfect storm)

[Chorus]
¡Patrones perfectos! (Perfect patterns!)
(Never end)
¡El tiempo y el espacio! (Time and space!)
(Start to bend)

[Extended Drop 2 - The music reaches maximum complexity, a wall of beautiful, structured noise]
(Zoom in forever!)
[Maximalist Orchestral Math-Bass Solo - 45 seconds]

[Outro - Abruptly snaps back to the single piano note from the intro]
Infinito. (Infinite.)
(Loop.)
